description: For an APPROVED agency: email a barber, stylist, shop, salon or school an invite to join ShearQuery. When they join through it, the business is credited to this agency (and earns commission when it pays for a plan). Sends a real email from ShearQuery naming the agency — confirm the address and business name with the agency before calling. Limits: 50 a day, and not the same address twice in a week.

business_name.description: Their business or name, used in the greeting. Optional.
